description: 10-year general cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk via the Framingham General CVD model (D'Agostino 2008). A published Cox-model risk equation, NOT a trained model (brief 2) — coefficients are encoded here with citations. `parameters` holds the measurement-noise priors that drive the confidence interval; `coefficients` holds the fixed sex-specific model constants.

sbp_measurement_sd.notes: Drives CI: a single clinic SBP reading carries this much measurement/biological noise.

total_chol_measurement_sd.citation: Biological + analytic variation in total cholesterol ~8 mg/dL (NCEP 1995)

hdl_measurement_sd.citation: Biological + analytic variation in HDL ~4 mg/dL (NCEP 1995)

coefficients._citation: D'Agostino RB et al. 2008, 'General Cardiovascular Risk Profile for Use in Primary Care: The Framingham Heart Study', Circulation 117:743-753. Covariates: ln(age), ln(total chol), ln(HDL), ln(SBP) treated/untreated, current smoker, diabetes. risk = 1 - S0^exp(sum(beta*x) - mean).
